Regressione: tab-shopping/recipes/water/weight/mood/calendar/photo all open without JS errors (2 benign 401 on /api/files GET without ?auth= — image preload race, non-blocking).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/foods/custom: upsert key uses {name, brand} when code is missing — if brand is empty string this may collide with other brand-less entries sharing the same name across users. Low risk but consider including created_by in the key for userscoped custom foods.
BarcodeScanner lookup swallows errors silently (modal just stays on custom-food-form regardless of why OFF failed); add toast on network/HTTP error to differentiate 'not found' from 'offline'.
/api/foods/search returns up to 8 custom + N OFF without deduping by barcode — if a custom food has the same code as an OFF entry both appear.

/api/files 401 appears in console when PhotoDiary mounts and reaches an entry whose image path 404'd previously; consider lazy-loading images only after a successful entry fetch or hide broken thumbnails to keep console clean.
